t2.thesis: Uber's open-to-open move across a BMO print is close to a coin flip: a beaten-down stock with strong fundamentals and bullish analysts is offset by a weak earnings-reaction history and a large, uncertain Delivery Hero deal overhang.
reasons: BMO base rate of 54.8% is the starting point; the entry open is the day before the print, so the exit open captures the full reaction.
The last 4 prints had a 25% win rate on the open-to-open measure (3 of 4 were negative despite beats), which suggests the market is skeptical on the reaction.
The stock is down about 31% over 12 months and 33% off its 52-week high, so expectations are low and sentiment is washed out, while analysts are very bullish (rec mean 1.58).
Implied move is about 7.8% with IV at 2.9x realized volatility, so the distribution is wide and the direction is nearly symmetric.
The Delivery Hero acquisition, debt raising, robotaxi competition and regulatory scrutiny (FTC pricing, UK VAT) add overhang risk.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 gross bookings guidance relative to the buy-side bar, together with commentary on Delivery Hero financing and the autonomous vehicle competitive threat.

prior.from: I3 BMO session base rate (0.548), consistent with overall validation 0.542 and consumer cluster 0.555

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-02, so the November 4, 2026 earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information about how Uber's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 4.8 points, from 0.548 to 0.50, for the poor recent earnings-reaction record and deal and AV overhangs, partly offset by depressed sentiment and strong guidance momentum.

theses.expected: Stock rises on gross bookings and EBITDA beats with Q4 guidance at or above consensus.
theses.mechanism: Depressed valuation (forward P/E about 15) and low sentiment make good guidance trigger a relief rally.
theses.wrong_if: Gross bookings guidance implies deceleration below about 18% constant currency growth.

theses.expected: Stock falls despite beating EPS, as in the past 3 of 4 prints.
theses.mechanism: Elevated expectations on bookings, margin investment and AV or Delivery Hero spending keep the reaction negative.
theses.wrong_if: Management shows margin expansion with disciplined investment and the stock opens up.

theses.expected: Muted, noisy reaction driven by the macro backdrop (midterms, jobs report, tech volatility).
theses.mechanism: Market-wide moves between the entry and exit opens dominate if the print is in line.
theses.wrong_if: The print produces a gap greater than 5% in either direction.

key_observations: Q4 gross bookings guidance vs consensus and constant currency growth rate
Q4 Adjusted EBITDA and EPS guidance
Delivery Hero deal financing, timing and leverage commentary

Mobility and Delivery growth rates and MAPC growth
